purpose: Copy 720 owned camera bytes while their mapped lifetime is valid, then forward the complete ENB Unmap including its shadow-copy work

original.pointer: ASLR loaded ENB base + 0x6b500, exact aligned 8-byte value

replacement: PointerPatch compare-and-swap to pinned unmapProxy in FgCameraWriteHooks.cpp; original ENB Unmap preserved exactly once
abi: ID3D11DeviceContext::Unmap, void STDMETHODCALLTYPE(context, resource, UINT subresource). Win64 ABI and original arguments preserved; incoming LastError restored before ENB. Copy before original call only, no mapped-pointer access afterward; no instruction relocation
activation: Paired with enb0505.context.camera-map-observe-v1 at verified renderer creation; both complete contracts validated before Map CAS and then Unmap CAS; diagnostic default false/restart scoped
lifetime: Pinned callback/ENB modules and forwarding state until process exit. Matching context/resource/subresource/thread required; failed or overlapping Map and buffer/context generation change invalidate evidence
recovery: Unknown owners are rejected without overwrite. Pair startup failure restores only acquired slots still owned; later owners survive. Irrecoverable rollback terminates. Disable at next startup with either ID, ProbeFgCameraWrites false, SafeMode or experimental hooks false
evidence: Ghidra and Capstone confirm ENB forwarding and Skyrim 720-byte producer
